question: residential roads GeoJSON
sql: SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'residential' LIMIT 50

question: paved footway WKT
sql: SELECT ST_AsText(geometry) AS wkt FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'footway' AND road_surface[1].value = 'paved' LIMIT 50

question: service roads start end lon lat
sql: SELECT ROUND(ST_X(ST_StartPoint(geometry))::DOUBLE,6) AS start_lon, ROUND(ST_Y(ST_StartPoint(geometry))::DOUBLE,6) AS start_lat, ROUND(ST_X(ST_EndPoint(geometry))::DOUBLE,6) AS end_lon, ROUND(ST_Y(ST_EndPoint(geometry))::DOUBLE,6) AS end_lat FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'service' LIMIT 20

question: footway length meters
sql: SELECT id, ROUND(ST_Length(ST_Transform(geometry,'EPSG:4326','EPSG:3763',always_xy:=true))) AS length_m FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'footway' LIMIT 20

question: secondary roads name and max speed
sql: SELECT CONCAT(names.primary,' max ',CAST(speed_limits[1].max_speed.value AS VARCHAR),' km/h') AS road_info FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'secondary' AND speed_limits[1].max_speed.value IS NOT NULL LIMIT 20

question: sidewalk roads extent GeoJSON
sql: SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Extent_Agg(geometry)) AS extent_geojson FROM lisbon_roads WHERE subclass = 'sidewalk'
